data.title: Shortest to Longest
data.description: Measure each shape with the ruler and put them in order from shortest to longest.

challenges.label: Sky Rectangle
challenges.hint: Find the number on the ruler where the shape ends.

challenges.label: Green Square
challenges.hint: Line the left edge up with 0, then read where the right edge lands.

challenges.label: Purple Rectangle
challenges.hint: Look where the right edge of the shape lines up on the ruler.

challenges.label: Blue Rectangle
challenges.hint: Count the big tick marks from 0 to the edge of the shape.
